compiled_state.description:
## Context
Story: 9e8b-cb61-b20a-4a54 — Phase F creates one sub-branch per tool-atomic tier in ci-pr mode

## Goal
Update plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md Phase F section to add ci-pr mode sub-branch creation instructions (one branch per tier, no per-bug chunking, zero-tier skip).

## Testing Mode: UPDATE

## File Impact
| Source File | Action | Test File | Classification |
|---|---|---|---|
| plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md | modify | tests/scripts/test-debug-everything-phase-f-subbranch.sh | needs-modification |
| .test-index | modify | n/a | n/a |

## Implementation Steps
1. Open plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md
2. Find Phase F section header (grep for '## Phase F')
3. Add a sub-branch instruction block at the PHASE F SECTION HEADER (not in a separate preamble) that covers ci-pr mode:

   **Sub-branch creation (ci-pr mode only — when DEBUG_MODE=pr)**:
   
   Phase F operates on two tool-atomic tiers: Tier 0 (format/make format) and Tier 1 (lint/ruff --fix). In ci-pr mode, create exactly one sub-branch per tier that produces changes:
   
   - Branch naming: bug-batch/<debug-session-id>/tier-0 and bug-batch/<debug-session-id>/tier-1
   - Use create-story-branch.sh with --prefix bug-batch/<debug-session-id> (or direct git checkout -b)
   - When a tier has zero applicable bugs/changes: no sub-branch is created AND no annotation is added to the aggregate draft PR for that tier
   - Apply all tier changes on the sub-branch and merge into the session branch before moving to the next tier
   
   In local mode (DEBUG_MODE=direct or absent): no sub-branch created; commit directly to session branch.

4. Remove RED marker entries for test_phase_f_* from .test-index

## Acceptance Criteria
- Phase F section header in SKILL.md contains sub-branch instructions (not in a separate preamble)
- SKILL.md references 'bug-batch/<debug-session-id>/tier-0' naming pattern for Phase F
- SKILL.md references 'tier-1' branch name for Phase F
- SKILL.md documents zero-bug-tier skip (no branch, no PR annotation)
- SKILL.md states one sub-branch per tier (no per-bug chunking)
- RED markers for test_phase_f_* removed from .test-index
- All 5 structural tests in test-debug-everything-phase-f-subbranch.sh now PASS
- bash tests/run-all.sh exits 0 (or only other RED tests fail)
- ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
- ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
